label: Wat Kio Phrao

scripts.label: Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา

samples: Tamnan Phra Chao Hai (Buddha Chao 2 Phra Ong)

lede: Wat Kio Phrao accounts for 4 catalogued manuscripts. It clusters in Chiang Rai (100% of the corpus for this temple). Nearly all (100%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. Dated witnesses run 1932–1945 CE (3 of 4 carry a date).
